_criterion: PREREGISTRATION.md AMENDMENT v1.1 §A1.2 — load_bearing = HIGH if EITHER a positive dependency (work presupposes the claim TRUE) OR a negation dependency (work presupposes the claim FALSE and must be re-read if it is true).
_scope: X1 and S1 (first pass), then T1 (second pass). The criterion-defined complete set is the 14 rows graded below HIGH under v1.0, since a union can only raise a grade. Rows T3, T5, T6, R1 and R3 were opened but NOT graded - see _unfinished.

positive_dependencies: Sun C et al., Cancer Immunol Res 2019 (PMID 31311791) — CD49a+ NK accumulation predicts poor HCC prognosis; its causal reading assumes a pre-existing liver-resident compartment turning bad. INTERPRETIVE.

Nixon BG et al., Sci Immunol 2022 (PMID 35394814) — IL-15 support of a locally maintained cytotoxic type-1 innate compartment, with a filed patent on targeting ILC1 IL-15 signalling. INTERVENTIONAL but entangled with the NK/ILC1 identity fork.
Annu Rev Immunol 2024 (PMID 38424658) — the multilayered tissue-resident-lymphocyte-in-cancer framework. FRAMING.
negation_dependencies: Serger C et al., Sci Immunol 2026 (PMID 42247486) — resolves two taNK subsets marked by ITGAE (CD103) and ITGA1 (CD49a) 'that display features of tissue residency', and asserts 'an inflammation-driven transition from early GZMK+ NK cells toward an ENTPD1+ (CD39+) effector state'. That transition presupposes the CD49a+CD103+ taNK arise by in-situ differentiation inside the tumour. If X1 is true and those cells were already lung-resident before the tumour, the trajectory is rooted in the wrong population. REGISTRY-INTERNAL: this is claim X4.

Gao Y et al., Nat Immunol 2017 (PMID 28759001) — 'TGF-beta-signaling-dependent conversion of NK cells (CD49a-CD49b+Eomes+) into intermediate ILC1 (CD49a+CD49b+Eomes+) and ILC1 populations in the tumor microenvironment'. The whole immunoevasion mechanism requires the intratumoural CD49a+ population to have been CD49a- NK first. If it was already resident, no conversion occurred and the mechanism loses its subject. MECHANISTIC.

Cortez VS et al., Nat Immunol 2017 (PMID 28759002) — 'SMAD4 impedes the conversion of NK cells into ILC1-like cells by curtailing non-canonical TGF-beta signaling'. The genetic arm underwriting the same conversion model, with the same presupposition. MECHANISTIC/GENETIC.

Horowitz NB et al., Sci Transl Med 2026 (PMID 42090477) — mechanistic framing states 'the context in which the differentiation of CD49a+CD103+ trNK cells occurs can result in either an immunosuppressive phenotype (e.g., decidual NK cells) or a highly cytotoxic one (e.g., some tumor trNK subsets)', which presupposes tumour trNK are differentiated in situ rather than pre-resident. NOTE: this paper sits on BOTH sides — its ACT platform is origin-agnostic (which is why v1.0 declined it as a positive dependency), but its mechanism is not.

Dominant-negative TGF-betaRII engineered NK cells as an adoptive-therapy strategy — e.g. cord-blood NK expressing DN TGF-betaRII (PMID 28109751), multigene-modified NK101 (PMID 36524207). The design rationale is that TME TGF-beta acts on INFILTRATING NK to suppress/convert them. INTERVENTIONAL, and it is the clearest negation-side dependency because a therapeutic construct is built on it.
X1.reason: Under the v1.0 one-directional criterion X1 graded MEDIUM because its headline positive dependency (Horowitz's ctrNK ACT platform) is origin-agnostic and survives X1 being false. That finding stands. What v1.0 could not see is that the dominant framework in this area - tumour TGF-beta converting infiltrating NK into a residency/ILC1-like phenotype - presupposes X1's NEGATION, and does so across four primary papers plus an engineered-cell therapeutic strategy. If the CD49a+CD103+ intratumoural population was already resident in the organ, the conversion those papers measure did not produce it, and both the mechanism and the trajectory rooted on it must be re-read. That is load in the sense criterion 1 exists to capture.
X1.registry_internal_note: X1 and X4 are mutually constraining, and the direction matters: X1 is UPSTREAM of X4. X4 (Serger 2026) asserts an inflammation-driven GZMK+ -> ENTPD1+ trajectory among intratumoural taNK. If X1 is true and those CD49a+CD103+ cells were already resident in the lung before the tumour, then the most likely reading of that trajectory is PRE-EXISTING RESIDENT HETEROGENEITY BEING READ AS A TRAJECTORY - the ordering would be over cells that differ because they arrived and were imprinted at different times, not because one state becomes the other. An assertion that can RE-INTERPRET another assertion is more load-bearing, not less: X1 does not merely share a dependency with X4, it can invalidate X4's root. X4 remains INF_TRAJECTORY under G2 regardless, and this note does not change X4's own grade - it records that X4's interpretation is conditional on X1.

positive_dependencies: Guo C et al., Cell Discov 2021 (PMID 33390590) — the section titled 'Aberrant differentiation trajectory impairs dNK1 cell subset accumulation in RPL patients'. Its entire disease model is that recurrent pregnancy loss is caused by a BLOCKED conversion toward dNK1, which requires an ordering to exist. INTERPRETIVE/DISEASE-MODEL.
negation_dependencies: The much larger body of decidual-NK association work that reports dNK1/dNK2/dNK3 PROPORTIONS as compositional readouts and interprets shifts as changes in subset abundance rather than as differentiation blockade. Huhn O et al., Nat Commun 2020 (PMID 31959757) is representative in assigning distinctive phenotypes and functions per subset. If an ordering does exist, every such proportion finding must be re-read as a flux/blockade measurement rather than a composition measurement, and the direction of that re-reading depends on a polarity the field does not agree on.

Vento-Tormo R et al., Nature 2018 (PMID 30429548) itself — it names dNK1/2/3 as 'three decidual NK cell STATES' and restricts its trajectory analysis to trophoblast. The atlas's own framing treats them as co-existing states, and the subset definitions everyone else inherits come from that framing.
S1.reason: S1 carries dependencies in BOTH directions, which under the v1.1 union raises it to HIGH: Guo 2021's RPL disease model requires an ordering, while the larger compositional literature presupposes none. The bidirectional criterion is what makes this visible - under v1.0 only the Guo side was counted, and one interpretive dependency graded MEDIUM.
S1.status_note: THIS CHANGES NOTHING. S1 fails shortlist criterion 3 on BOTH decidability gates (lineage_decidable = FALSE, both_answers_actionable = FALSE) independently of load-bearing, because the asserted ordering is a directed arrow over a reversible, milieu-instructed state and clonal structure cannot order a reversible state. The re-grade is recorded for the register, not to change membership.
S1.independent_finding: S1's audit finding stands on its own regardless of grade: Vento-Tormo 2018, the paper that defines dNK1/2/3, makes no ordering claim at all, and the three papers that do assert one give mutually incompatible topologies.

positive_dependencies: Dominant-negative TGFBR2 / TGFBR2-knockout NK and CAR-NK products, justified on the premise that tumour TGF-beta CONVERTS infused conventional NK into non-cytotoxic CD49a+ ILC1-like cells. Found by T1's own v1.0 audit; the v1.0 adversarial pass challenged how much weight it carries, which is why T1 graded MEDIUM.
negation_dependencies: Sojka DK et al., eLife 2014 (PMID 24714492) - the title states T1's negation outright: 'Tissue-resident natural killer (NK) cells are cell lineages DISTINCT FROM thymic and conventional splenic NK cells'. Parabiosis plus Eomes/T-bet. The entire trNK-as-separate-lineage nomenclature rests on this.

Klose CSN et al., Cell 2014 (PMID 24725403) - 'Differentiation of type 1 ILCs from a common progenitor to all helper-like innate lymphoid cell lineages'. Establishes a separate progenitor architecture (CHILP) for helper-like ILC1, distinct from the NKP that feeds cNK.
Nixon BG et al., Sci Immunol 2022 (PMID 35394814) - ILC-progenitor fate mapping plus transfer, reporting that the ILC1 lineage 'did not interconvert with NK cells'.

Consequence: the ILC classification and ontogeny framework - separate progenitors, non-interconverting lineages - presupposes that tissue type-1 innate lymphocytes are NOT cNK-derived. If cNK routinely convert to the tissue-resident phenotype, the lineage boundary that framework is built on is porous, and a large body of subset nomenclature has to be re-read as states rather than lineages.
T1.reason: T1 graded MEDIUM under v1.0 after the adversarial pass discounted its single positive dependency. The negation side is far larger and was invisible to the one-directional criterion: a foundational paper asserts T1's negation in its title, and the ILC ontogeny framework generalises it. Under the v1.1 union this is HIGH.
T1.status_note: THIS CHANGES NOTHING. T1 fails shortlist criterion 4 (already_traced = TRUE, HIGH confidence) independently of load-bearing. Re-graded for register consistency, because a MEDIUM sitting next to X1's HIGH on an adjacent claim was an internal inconsistency worth removing.
T1.relation_to_X1: T1 and X1 are near-complementary, and the DN-TGFBR2 construct shows it: the same therapeutic premise requires T1 TRUE (TGF-beta converts infused cNK) and X1 FALSE (intratumoural trNK are infiltrating-and-converted, not pre-resident). One construct, opposite directions on two adjacent claims.

_unfinished.why: A bidirectional re-grade needs the same search depth as the Phase A adversarial pass. Targeted searches for the negation side of these five returned reviews rather than primary sources, so no negation dependency was ESTABLISHED. Under G3 that is NOT_SEARCHED-equivalent, not NONE, and under G7 a grade must not be raised on an unverified dependency. Their v1.0 grades therefore stand and remain flagged v1.0_positive_only.
_unfinished.membership_impact: None. T3 and T5 are blocked by already_traced=TRUE; T3, T5, T6, R1 and R3 are all additionally blocked by criterion 3.
_unfinished.note: These six are part of the criterion-defined set (below HIGH under v1.0) but were not in the requested batch. All are blocked by an independent criterion.
